aiConsent.title: AI features send messages off your device
aiConsent.body:
Chatterbox encrypts your messages so only you and the other person can read them. AI is the one exception.

To summarise, translate or transcribe, the selected messages are decrypted on this device and sent to our server and its AI provider. They are sent to produce your result, not to train anything — but in transit and in processing they are not end-to-end encrypted.

Everything else stays encrypted: messages you don't run AI on, your shared lists.

You can turn this off at any time in Profile.
aiConsent.settingsOn: Allowed — selected messages are sent off this device when you use AI.
aiConsent.settingsOff: Off — nothing is sent. You'll be asked before any AI feature runs.
aiConsent.turnedOff: AI features turned off on this device

linkPreview.settingsOn: On — when you send a link, this device fetches its title and image once and encrypts them into the message. The person you send it to never asks our server about the link.
linkPreview.settingsOff: Off — links you send stay plain links, and our server is never told about them.
linkPreview.turnedOff: Link previews turned off on this device

account.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes your account, profile, moments, saved items and the messages you sent. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteWhatHappens:
This permanently deletes:

• Your profile, moments, saved items and friend connections
• Messages and media you sent, in every conversation
• Your encryption keys stored on this device

Messages other people sent you stay in their own copy of the conversation.

This cannot be undone.

tutorial.welcomeBody: Let's take a quick tour of the essentials — it only takes a few taps.
tutorial.chatsBody: All your conversations live in the Chats tab. Unread messages show a badge there.
tutorial.newChatBody: Tap the + in Chats to send someone an invite link, or open one they sent you.
tutorial.composerBody: In a chat you can send photos, files, voice notes and GIFs, reply or @mention, and even schedule a message for later.
tutorial.spacesBody: Open a chat's menu for the media gallery and collaborative lists — both end-to-end encrypted, like the messages.
tutorial.callsBody: Call anyone right from the chat — one tap for voice, one for video.
tutorial.momentsBody: Share photos and updates with your friends, and see what they post.
tutorial.profileBody: Set your name, theme, language and privacy here — and replay this tour anytime.
tutorial.doneBody: That's the tour. You can replay it whenever you like from your profile.
tutorial.settingsDescription: New here? Take the guided tour of Chatterbox.

keys.restoreBody: This looks like a new device for an account that already has an encryption key. Restore your recovery phrase to keep reading old messages, or continue and start fresh.
keys.supersededBody: This device's key was replaced from another device, so messages sent to you since then can't be opened here. Enter that device's recovery phrase to read them.

invite.openIntro: Paste a link someone sent you. It works once, and only for the person who sent it.
